a914f3684c2034c9125d53038cb23079188dfdc2.sourceText: 以后实车需要测量实际同步状态；如果发现偏移，必须先确认校正方式及其符号，再处理对应代码或驱动配置。当前把 time_diff_lidar_to_imu 填成非零值，不会完成校正。
a914f3684c2034c9125d53038cb23079188dfdc2.translatedText: In the future, the actual vehicle will need to measure the real synchronization state; if an offset is found, the correction method and its sign must first be confirmed before handling the corresponding code or driver configuration\. Currently, setting time_diff_lidar_to_imu to a nonzero value will not complete the correction\.

a985d9588b0a9749c8ad358be9dc95add895147d.sourceText: 每个1.0 m缓存分块的新入点计数达到100，或距离该块上次更新达到1.0秒，就重新降采样并筛除过期点；清图事件也会强制更新。计数在更新后清零，计时采用输入点云时间。
a985d9588b0a9749c8ad358be9dc95add895147d.translatedText: For each 1\.0 m cache block, when the new entry point count reaches 100 or 1\.0 second has elapsed since the block was last updated, re\-downsample and filter out expired points; a map clear event also forces an update\. The count is reset to zero after the update, and timing uses the input point cloud time\.
